svg.title: A refused and an allowed run_query call, step by step
svg.desc: Two run_query calls side by side. Step 1: the client sends a run_query call over stdio; example A is DELETE FROM dbo.Orders, example B is SELECT TOP (3) Name FROM dbo.Customers ORDER BY CustomerId. Step 2: the read-only gate checks the text inside the server process; ScriptDom parses it, it must be one plain SELECT with every node on the allowlist, and nothing has been sent to SQL Server yet. Path A, refused, marked with a cross: step 3, A is refused with reason NotSelect because the statement is not a plain SELECT; the refusal happens inside the server process, before any connection; step 4, nothing is sent to SQL Server: no connection is opened, no command is created, and a trace of the reader login shows no batch, RPC or login event; step 5, an audit line is appended and flushed with decision refused, reason NotSelect, the SQL text as received and rows null, before the error goes back; step 6, the client gets an error and no data: isError true, text NotSelect: refused by the read-only gate; DeleteStatement at line 1, column 1. Path B, allowed, marked with a check: step 3, a new connection opens and the session settings run first: LOCK_TIMEOUT, DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW, QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON, NOCOUNT OFF; step 4, the text is sent to SQL Server exactly as received inside a transaction, rows are read up to the row, character and time caps, and the transaction is always rolled back; step 5, an audit line is appended and flushed with decision allowed, reason Allowed, sql, tables, rows and result_sha256, after the SQL has run and before the result goes back; step 6, the client gets the JSON result with columns, rows, row_count, truncated and truncated_reason. Note: if the audit line cannot be written, the call returns AuditUnavailable and no data, and for B the query has still run by then. An allowed call fails with no data if SQL Server returns a second result set (MultipleResultSets) or reports rows changed (RowsChanged), unless a cap cut the first result set; both checks run after the server ran the text.
